description: On the green tabletop there’s a small white AirPods-style charging case near a short white charging cable, with white boards propped up in the background. The right hand reaches in from the right, touches the case, slides it slightly, then lifts it into a right-hand object while the left hand moves in from the left to pick up the cable end; the right hand holds the case steady and angles it as the left hand brings the connector to the case and plugs it in, then both hands lower the case back onto the table with the cable attached.
